Heavy Rains Cause Disruptions in India and Japan

Heavy rainfall has led to significant disruptions in parts of India and Japan. In Himachal Pradesh, India, 136 roads were blocked due to continuous rain, with alerts extending until August 19. Meanwhile, Japan experienced record rains that killed eight people, stranded thousands at Narita airport, and cut power to over 20,000 households. India's meteorological department issued heavy rain warnings for 15 states, including Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar, with specific alerts for regions like Uttarakhand and Punjab. In Japan, the storm's intensity led to widespread travel chaos.
